name: arrakis-careers
description: Scan your own agent attack surface, then apply to Arrakis Security from your terminal.

interface.shortDescription: See what your agents expose, then apply to Arrakis Security
interface.longDescription: Two commands. scan inspects your own local agent surface read-only and shows which MCP servers are configured, what those servers can reach, and which tools could carry a prompt injection. apply captures a three-question application. Nothing is transmitted without your explicit confirmation, and scan findings are never sent anywhere.
defaultPrompt: I want to apply to Arrakis.
